'''GEMP''' is a browser rules engine for CCGs with server-adjudicated play. Players used [[Holotable]] for online play before GEMP. The Star Wars CCG table at play.swccg.com descends from the Lord of the Rings TCG GEMP ([[Christian McCarty|Ketura]] / Player’s Council pattern).

* '''This instance''' — [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]. Independent table.
* '''Players Committee instance''' — gemp.starwarsccg.org. Not this site.

Planned work, including further [[Anything Goes]] rules and a [[True Sabacc]] game mode, is listed on [[GEMP planned features]].
